item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Wonder Fool
  • 発売日: 2023-10-27
  • スコア: 6.83/10 (35 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 彼方の人魚姫
  • 英語名: Kanata no Ningyo Hime

あらすじ

Tatsumiya Village is located in the southernmost region of Japan. Time flows leisurely in a place where its residents have a strong affection for their hometown. In this village which has been with the sea for a long time, the villagers believe in mermaids, and the only shrine of the village is dedicated to them.

あらすじ

“The city of Minami-Ose is one of the places where it snows the most every winter in Japan and has one of the lowest population densities in Japan. With the first snowfall in the last few decades, I have noticed that something is going to change. But I’m not sure if I’m really capable of preparing for such a change.”

item.description:

  • ブランド: Wonder Fool
  • 発売日: 2017-10-27

  • 日本語名: 純情化憐フリークス！
  • 英語名: Junjou Karen Freaks!

别名

  • Freaks Romanticism

あらすじ

Supernatural beings such as youkai and spirits, called “freaks”, co-exist with humans in this world. Mikitaka lives with his older cousin Shizumi on the island of Kakuriyotobari, where 80% of the residents are freaks. One day, his childhood friend and first love Yuuka returned… as a ghost! She didn’t know why she became a ghost, and they let her stay with them since they’re old friends.

item.title: Natsu no Majo no Parade
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Wonder Fool
  • 発売日: 2016-09-30
  • スコア: 7.390000000000001/10 (90 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 夏の魔女のパレード
  • 英語名: Natsu no Majo no Parade

别名

  • 夏日魔女大游行

あらすじ

In a slightly different world, girls called ‘witches’ who are born with a rare mysterious ability are required to use their powers to help people. Living in the rural village of Kanahara-mura, Yukito is the son of the great witch Yuris. However, he has no magic ability whatsoever and lives a normal life like any other young boy. He thought his days would continue like this, until three witches-in-training appeared before him. The girls, Arisa, Carol and Topia, came to complete their graduation training “Witches’ Parade” in order to become a full-fledged witch. They ended up freeloading at his house, and he was asked to watch over them. He couldn’t just leave these eccentric girls who are new to the area alone, so he agreed to the request. However, that wasn’t the end of his suffering.
